vehicle_description: Meridian is a premium, spacious SUV that blends rugged Jeep capability with refined comfort and advanced tech, offering versatile 5- and 7-seat layouts, strong diesel performance, and seamless connectivity for confident daily drives and long journeys.
feature_summary:
- The Jeep Meridian is a premium, feature-rich SUV from Jeep India that blends bold SUV design, robust performance, advanced safety technology, a refined interior, and modern connectivity. The official ex-showroom price range starts from ₹23.33 lakh - rest assured that you will get the best deal at the dealership. It stands out with a strong 2.0 L Multijet II diesel engine paired with a 9-speed automatic or 6-speed manual, capable performance in both 4x2 and 4x4 configurations, and legendary Jeep capability. The exterior combines a powerful stance with signature Jeep design cues, LED headlamps, muscular body lines and 18-inch alloy wheels that convey both presence and capability. Inside, Meridian offers a premium cabin with spacious seating in 5-seater and 7-seater options, 12-way powered front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, leather/vegan leather upholstery, and flexible boot space. The SUV’s infotainment is anchored by a large Uconnect touchscreen (10.1-inch) with wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, integrated navigation, connected car features including Alexa Home-to-Vehicle support, remote engine start/stop with AC pre-conditioning and smartwatch connectivity, making it tech-forward and intuitive. Meridian also emphasises entertainment with a quality audio system and immersive digital displays. On the safety front, it comes standard with six airbags, ABS with EBD, traction control, electronic stability control, hill start assist, electronic parking brake, tyre pressure monitoring system, 360° cameras and a comprehensive ADAS suite (Adaptive Cruise Control, Forward Collision Mitigation Braking, Lane Keep Assist, Blind Spot Detection, Intelligent Speed Assist and more) on top trims, delivering high confidence and protection. 
 - The variant lineup for Jeep Meridian as per the official Jeep India site and updated market guides includes Longitude, Longitude Plus, Limited (O), and Overland, each catering to different customer needs and budget brackets with official ex-showroom pricing starting around ₹23.33 Lakh* for the base Meridian Longitude and rising to the top-spec Overland 4×4 AT. The Longitude variant offers essential SUV highlights like LED headlights with DRLs, roof rails, dual-zone climate control, a semi-digital instrument cluster, 10.1-inch infotainment with wireless smartphone connectivity, basic safety suite and cruise control, making it a strong value proposition. The Longitude Plus builds on this by adding a panoramic sunroof, contrast roof, wireless charger, leather steering wheel, auto-dimming IRVM, and third-row reclining seats for greater comfort and convenience. The Limited (O) variant steps up the luxury and technology with features like powered 8-way driver and front passenger seats with memory, ventilated seats, a larger digital instrument cluster, a premium Alpine 9-speaker sound system, third-row AC vents, a powered tailgate and a 360° camera, enhancing the Meridian’s upscale appeal. The Overland is the top-tier offering that adds chrome accents, suede interior touches, 4×4 capability with Jeep Active Drive and Selec-Terrain, and a comprehensive Level-2 ADAS suite (including adaptive cruise, lane departure warnings, collision mitigation and more) for the most advanced safety and off-road confidence. Additionally, Jeep has introduced special editions like Meridian X and Meridian Upland that bring unique styling and accessory enhancements for lifestyle and adventurous buyers.
 - The Meridian’s colour palette includes a variety of premium exterior shades such as Techno Metallic Green, Brilliant Black, Pearl White, Velvet Red, Magnesio Grey, Galaxy Blue, Silvery Moon and Minimal Grey, allowing buyers to personalise their SUV’s presence. 
 - When compared with competitors such as the Toyota Fortuner, MG Gloster, and Skoda Kodiaq, the Jeep Meridian offers several compelling advantages. Against the Toyota Fortuner, Meridian generally comes at a lower entry price while still delivering sophisticated interior technology, advanced connectivity and modern ADAS capabilities that are optional or less comprehensive on the Fortuner, making Meridian a strong choice for tech-centric buyers seeking a premium SUV experience. Versus the MG Gloster, while both offer ADAS and premium features, Meridian combines legendary Jeep off-road credibility with a more engaging driving feel and connected tech (Alexa integration, remote pre-conditioning) that gives it an edge in usability and lifestyle integration. In comparison to the Skoda Kodiaq, Meridian typically offers better value with its competitive feature set and 4×4 capability options at a similar price point, along with Jeep’s rugged brand heritage appealing to customers valuing both urban luxury and trail capability. Overall, the Jeep Meridian stands out for its blend of advanced safety technology, robust performance, premium interior comfort, and modern connectivity features, positioning it as a compelling choice in the premium SUV segment.

vehicle_description: Basalt X is a bold coupe-style SUV that combines sleek, expressive design with spacious comfort and smart technology, delivering a refined yet adventurous drive with advanced connectivity, premium features, and confident performance for everyday urban and highway journeys.
vehicle_type_aliases: SUV, Sport Utility Vehicle, mid size suv
feature_summary:
- The Citroen Basalt X is India’s first SUV-Coupe in its segment, combining bold French styling with comfort-led engineering and certified safety to deliver a distinctive yet practical driving experience. an official ex-showroom price range starts from ₹8.14 lakh - rest assured that you will get the best deal at the dealership. Built around Citroen’s global comfort DNA, it merges SUV versatility with a sporty coupe silhouette, offering strong road presence alongside everyday usability. The Basalt X has earned a 4-Star Safety Rating from Bharat NCAP for both Adult and Child Occupant Protection, confirming its strong structural integrity and crash performance under official testing standards. Supporting this rating, it comes equipped with comprehensive passive safety features including 6 airbags (driver, passenger, side and curtain), 3-point seatbelts for all occupants, seatbelt reminders for every seat, and ISOFIX child seat anchors with top tether, ensuring protection across the cabin. Active safety systems such as ESP (Electronic Stability Program), Hill Hold Assist, and ABS with EBD enhance stability, maintain grip during sudden manoeuvres, prevent skidding, and avoid rollback on inclines, helping prevent accidents before they occur. Visibility and driver awareness are strengthened with the Halo 360° Camera, reverse parking sensors, auto-dimming IRVM, LED Vision projector headlamps, projector fog lamps, and signature LED DRLs, providing confidence in tight city spaces and low-light conditions. The vehicle also proactively safeguards occupants through features like the Tyre Pressure Monitoring System and High Speed Alert system, which issues warnings at 80 km/h and continuous alerts at 120 km/h, ensuring risks are identified early. 
 - Beyond safety, the Basalt X offers a connected ecosystem with remote AC pre-conditioning, remote lock/unlock, live vehicle diagnostics, and full integration with the MyCitroen app. Inside, the technology experience is anchored by a 10.25-inch lag-free touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, wireless charging, and a 7-inch digital driver display, delivering seamless connectivity. A key highlight in higher variants is CARA, India’s first intelligent in-car companion in the segment, designed to go beyond basic voice commands by enabling continuous, contextual conversation. CARA personalizes interactions by remembering user preferences, supports navigation, weather updates, flight status checks, and real-time information access, enables calling and SOS assistance, controls multimedia functions, and even provides vehicle-related guidance. With multilingual capability and natural speech recognition, CARA transforms the cabin into an interactive and intelligent environment. Together, certified crash safety, active stability systems, preventive alerts, connected technology, and AI-powered assistance position the Citroen Basalt X as a stylish, secure, and smart SUV-coupe built for modern drivers. 
 - Regarding variants and their unique highlights, Basalt is offered in three core trims: You, Plus and Max, with multiple variant permutations including NA and Turbo petrol options, and manual/automatic gearboxes. The 'Plus' variant adds a more upscale experience with LED DRLs, wheel covers, body-coloured handles, ORVM turn indicators, interior dual-tone trim, a larger touchscreen, digital driver display, height-adjustable driver seat and TPMS, elevating both comfort and tech. vehicle_description: Aircross is a spacious, family-friendly SUV that blends Citroën’s advanced comfort-focused ride, smart tech, and versatile seating with practical everyday usability, delivering confident performance, thoughtful connectivity, and refined comfort for urban and highway journeys alike.
feature_summary:
- The Citroen Aircross X is a bold and versatile SUV designed for modern Indian families, combining French design sophistication with SUV strength and everyday practicality. The official ex-showroom price starts from ₹8.29 lakh for the 5-Seater and ₹10.99 lakh for the 7-Seater - rest assured that you will get the best deal at the dealership. Built around Citroen's global comfort DNA and engineered in India, the Aircross X offers commanding road presence with 200 mm ground clearance, a muscular stance, and distinctive diamond-cut alloy wheels that enhance its strong SUV identity. Designed for flexibility, the Aircross X is available in both 5-seater and 7-seater configurations, with the 7-seater featuring Flexi-Pro seating, removable third-row seats, 60:40 split second-row tumble function, and a 3-step recline feature for maximum adaptability between passengers and luggage. Comfort remains central to the Aircross X experience with Citroen's signature suspension tuning that delivers a smooth and planted ride across varying road conditions. Best-in-class tropicalised automatic climate control, rear AC vents, rear roof vents (7-seater), and Tropicool ventilated front seats ensure superior cabin comfort even during peak Indian summers. The lounge-inspired interior features soft-touch materials, leatherette upholstery in higher trims, diffused ambient lighting, and a refined dual-tone cabin theme that creates a premium and relaxed driving environment. On the technology front, the Aircross X comes equipped with a 10.25-inch Citroen Connect floating touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, paired with a 7-inch coloured digital TFT instrument cluster. Wireless charging, multiple Type-C fast charging ports across rows, cruise control with speed limiter, and Proxi-Sense passive entry with push start enhance convenience and everyday usability. A key highlight in higher variants is CARA, India's intelligent in-car companion, designed to go beyond basic voice commands with continuous conversations, personalised interactions, navigation assistance, weather updates, multimedia control, SOS support, and real-time information access with multilingual capability, transforming the cabin into a smart and interactive ecosystem. The Aircross X also integrates 40+ connected features through the MyCitroen Connect app including remote engine start/stop with pre-conditioning, geo-fencing, remote lock/unlock, intrusion alerts, fuel status monitoring, and vehicle tracking. The Aircross has a 5-star Bharat NCAP rating for Adult Occupant Protection and 4 stars for Child Occupant Protection. Safety is comprehensive with 6 airbags, Electronic Stability Program (ESP), Hill Hold Assist, ABS with EBD, ISOFIX child seat anchors with top tether, Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS), reverse parking sensors, electrochromic auto-dimming IRVM, and an available 360° camera system, along with high-speed alert warnings at 80 km/h and continuous alerts at 120 km/h to enhance preventive safety. Under the hood, the Aircross X offers PureTech petrol powertrains including a 1.2L naturally aspirated engine and a 1.2L turbo petrol engine with 5-speed manual, 6-speed manual, and 6-speed torque converter automatic transmission options, delivering strong mid-range performance with competitive fuel efficiency. 
 - Regarding variants and their unique highlights, Aircross X is offered in three core trims: You, Plus, and Max across both 5-seater and 7-seater configurations with NA and Turbo petrol options. The entry-level 'You' 5-Seater starts at ₹8.29 lakh and focuses on essentials with 6 airbags, ABS, ESP, Hill Hold Assist, manual AC, reverse parking sensors, and core comfort features, delivering strong value at the base price. The 7-Seater range starts from ₹10.99 lakh and adds flexible third-row seating with enhanced practicality for larger families. The 'Plus' variant enhances the experience with a larger touchscreen, digital cluster, automatic climate control (with turbo), rear AC vents, additional charging ports, cruise control in select variants, and improved interior trims, offering a balanced mix of comfort and technology. The top-end 'Max' variant adds 17-inch diamond-cut alloy wheels, leatherette upholstery, ambient lighting, wireless charger, electrochromic IRVM, connected car features with 40+ smart functions, CARA intelligent assistant (in automatic variant), Proxi-Sense passive entry with push start, and dual-tone roof options, delivering a premium and tech-forward experience. 
 - In terms of colours available for Aircross X, buyers can choose from monotone shades including Polar White, Steel Grey, Deep Forest Green, Cosmo Blue, Garnet Red, and Perla Nera Black, along with dual-tone combinations like Polar White with Black roof, Deep Forest Green with Black roof, Cosmo Blue with Polar White roof, and Garnet Red with Black roof, offering both elegant and sporty styling choices. 
 - When compared with key competitors such as Hyundai Creta, Kia Seltos and Tata Curvv, the Aircross X stands out with its flexible 5 and 7-seater configuration, removable third-row seats, comfort-focused suspension tuning, and intelligent in-car assistant technology. While rivals may emphasize feature density or performance orientation, Aircross X prioritizes ride comfort, cabin flexibility, connected convenience, and family-centric usability, making it a compelling alternative for buyers seeking space, practicality, and distinctive European-inspired design at a competitive starting price.

vehicle_description: Premium mid-size SUV with advanced technology, strong performance, and enhanced comfort, positioned above compact SUVs
feature_summary:
- The Mahindra XUV 7XO is Mahindra’s most advanced compact SUV, engineered to deliver a strong balance of bold SUV design, premium interiors, high performance, and segment-leading safety with modern connected technology. The official ex-showroom price of the Mahindra XUV 7XO starts from ₹13.66 lakh for the base petrol variant and extends up to approximately ₹24.92 lakh for the top-end diesel automatic variant, as per Mahindra’s official pricing structure, ensuring customers receive a feature-rich and safety-focused SUV positioned competitively in its segment. Built on Mahindra’s latest safety-oriented platform, the XUV 7XO combines muscular road presence with refined ride quality, making it suitable for both city commuting and long-distance highway travel while maintaining everyday practicality and premium appeal. 
 -From a design and exterior perspective, the Mahindra XUV 7XO showcases a modern SUV character with a bold front fascia, Bi-LED projector headlamps with signature LED DRLs, a wide grille with chrome detailing, flush-fitting door handles, sculpted body lines, sporty skid plates, roof rails, and distinctive alloy wheel designs up to 19 inches on higher variants. The rear is highlighted by C-shaped LED tail lamps and a wide tailgate, reinforcing a planted and premium stance. These elements collectively give the XUV 7XO a commanding on-road presence that visually differentiates it from conventional compact SUVs while retaining a clean and contemporary design language. 
 - Inside the cabin, the XUV 7XO focuses heavily on space, comfort, and perceived quality, offering a wide and airy interior with a long wheelbase that translates into generous rear legroom and headroom. The dashboard follows a layered, premium design theme with soft-touch materials, satin chrome accents, piano-black inserts, and ambient lighting on higher variants. Comfort features such as electrically adjustable front seats, ventilated seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, rear AC vents, panoramic sunroof, wireless charging, multiple fast-charging USB Type-C ports, and large door pockets ensure that both front and rear passengers enjoy a relaxed and premium experience during daily usage as well as long journeys. 
 -Technology and infotainment form one of the strongest pillars of the XUV 7XO, led by a futuristic triple-screen layout that includes a large touchscreen infotainment system, a fully digital instrument cluster, and an integrated display for connected features. The infotainment system supports wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, built-in navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, steering-mounted controls, and over-the-air software updates. Mahindra’s AdrenoX connected car platform enables features such as remote engine start, remote climate control, vehicle tracking, geofencing, live diagnostics, and location sharing via a smartphone app, bringing a true connected-SUV experience to the segment. 
 - Entertainment and in-car experience are enhanced through a premium multi-speaker sound system on higher variants, delivering rich audio clarity for music, navigation prompts, and calls. The integration of voice-based controls, including AI-assisted conversational commands, allows drivers to operate infotainment, climate functions, navigation, and vehicle features with minimal distraction, further improving safety and convenience during driving. 
 - Safety is a major highlight of the Mahindra XUV 7XO, as it comes with a comprehensive safety package designed to meet modern crash and stability standards. The SUV is equipped with up to 6 airbags, ABS with EBD, Electronic Stability Control, Hill Hold Assist, traction control, ISOFIX child-seat mounts, seatbelt reminders for all occupants, and a high-speed alert system. Advanced driver assistance features available on higher variants include a 360-degree surround-view camera, front and rear parking sensors, tyre pressure monitoring system, driver drowsiness detection, adaptive cruise control, and lane-related assistance systems, ensuring both preventive and protective safety for occupants. 
 - In terms of variants and positioning, the Mahindra XUV 7XO is offered in AX, AX3, AX5, AX7, AX7 T (Tech), and AX7 L (Luxury) trims, allowing customers to choose based on their budget and feature priorities. The AX variant focuses on core essentials with strong safety, LED lighting, digital displays, and a solid infotainment setup, making it an excellent value-driven entry point. The AX3 adds functional upgrades such as reverse camera, enhanced convenience features, and improved cabin usability. The AX5 builds further by adding alloy wheels, panoramic sunroof, and additional comfort features, making it suitable for buyers seeking a balance between price and premium appeal. 
 - The AX7 variant elevates the experience with larger alloy wheels, dual-zone climate control, advanced connected features, enhanced interior materials, and surround-view camera technology, positioning it as a well-rounded premium offering. The AX7 T focuses on technology-centric buyers by adding ventilated seats, premium audio system, electronic parking brake, and advanced driver assistance features. The top-end AX7 L variant emphasizes luxury with larger wheels, multi-zone ambient lighting, powered passenger seat, rear comfort enhancements, and exclusive interior finishes, making it the most feature-loaded and refined version of the XUV 7XO. 
 - Colour options for the Mahindra XUV 7XO include a wide range of monotone and dual-tone finishes such as Pearl White, Shadow Grey, Dignity Black, Deep Ocean Blue, Ruby Red, Desert Sand, and premium dual-tone combinations with contrasting black roofs, allowing buyers to choose between elegant, sporty, or bold visual themes based on personal preference. 
 - When compared with key competitors like the Hyundai Creta, Kia Seltos, and Tata Curvv, the Mahindra XUV 7XO stands out primarily due to its stronger emphasis on safety, advanced technology, and premium interior experience. Against the Creta and Seltos, which focus more on comfort and brand familiarity, the XUV 7XO offers a more comprehensive safety package, larger digital displays, and deeper connected-car integration, giving it a technological edge. In comparison with the Tata Curvv, which leans towards sporty design and performance-oriented dynamics, the XUV 7XO prioritizes cabin comfort, family-friendly features, and long-distance ride quality, making it a better choice for buyers seeking a balanced, feature-rich, and safety-focused SUV without moving into a significantly higher price bracket.
